program.welcome: Boys and girls of every skill level are welcome
about: We're a volunteer-run youth basketball club. Players learn to dribble, pass, shoot, and defend, and they learn to play as a team.
Younger players use smaller balls and lower hoops where we can, so every kid can score. Every player gets real playing time.

pillars.title: Skills First
pillars.text: Ball handling, passing, and shooting at every age.

pillars.title: Everyone Plays
pillars.text: Fair playing time for every player, every game.

pillars.title: Play Together
pillars.text: Share the ball, help on defense, cheer for your team.

pillars.title: Have Fun
pillars.text: Winter weekends, big shots, and good friends.

groups.name: Rookies
groups.text: Fun drills and simple games, often on a lower hoop with a smaller ball.

groups.name: Juniors
groups.text: Team play, basic rules, and man-to-man defense.

groups.name: Seniors
groups.text: Full games, plays, and more competition.

groups_intro: Teams are formed by age and grade so every game is fair and fun.

join_steps.title: Ask Us
join_steps.text: Email us with your child's age and any questions. We'll tell you which team fits.

join_steps.title: Try a Practice
join_steps.text: Come watch or join a practice. No commitment, no cost.

join_steps.title: Register
join_steps.text: Fill out the registration, medical, and permission forms before the season starts, and you're on the team.

uniform: We provide a reversible jersey. Players need clean basketball or court shoes (no black soles on gym floors), athletic shorts, and a water bottle.

safety.title: Player Safety
points: Every coach and volunteer completes abuse-prevention training and a background check before working with players.
Two adults are present at every practice and game. No adult is ever alone with a player who isn't their own child.
Coaches learn the signs of a concussion. Any player with a suspected head injury sits out until a health care provider clears them.
We post photos of players only with written permission from a parent or guardian, and never with a player's full name.

faq.a: No. We teach the basics, and every player gets playing time.

faq.q: When and where do you practice and play?

faq.a: Clean court shoes, athletic shorts, and a water bottle. A ball at home helps (size 5 for ages 8 and under, size 6 for older girls and younger boys, size 7 for older boys).
Every team needs a few helpers: coaches, team parents, snack and field volunteers. No experience needed, and we'll train you.

faq.q: Can we try it before signing up?
faq.a: Yes! Email {email} and we'll invite you to a practice.
